## Long-form bio
Adnan Khan is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Stitch and Co-Founder of Stitch Predict, both based in Auckland, New Zealand. Over the last 19 years he has led digital transformation, customer data, marketing technology and AI work for some of the most demanding brands in the world.

He joined Facebook in August 2009 as the 5th Facebook employee in APAC and the first Account Manager in Facebook APAC, becoming one of the first 200 sales employees globally. He went on to lead Facebook in New Zealand as Country Manager between 2013 and 2014, after senior client partner and account roles across ANZ. Before that he spent a year at Microsoft Australia as a Technical Account Manager, and started his career as a digital media planner and buyer at Initiative Media in Sydney.

In 2014 he co-founded krunch.co as a founding partner, leading digital and then business development and innovation through to 2019. The krunch.co team pioneered the ANZ-first integration of Facebook Lead Ads with Marketo, built the first people-based attribution product in ANZ, delivered the first SkyTV + Telescope + Facebook live TV integration, and produced the world's first global integrated digital transformation, marketing automation, digital media, people-based attribution and business intelligence case study, for Cisco. Heritage clients from this era include Cisco, Comvita, Bank of New Zealand, Bayleys, Hyundai, Canon, Toyota and Honda.

He led the Comvita Marketo transformation that delivered a 480% increase in new lead conversion in six months and a 255% uplift in average sale value on nurture, with email becoming the second-highest revenue source online.

In May 2019 he co-founded Stitch, an Auckland-based consultancy specialising in media, marketing, advertising and data-driven technology. In October 2023 he co-founded Stitch Predict, a marketing mix modelling SaaS platform that isolates the causal impact of each marketing activity on business outcomes using large data and machine learning, with no reliance on cookies or device tracking.

Adnan was also a board member and investor in ListingLogic between 2013 and 2020, which culminated in a 700% return successful exit.

He chairs the Marketing Association of New Zealand's Digital Special Interest Group, leads the IAB NZ AI Working Group, contributes to the IAB NZ Emerging Technology Council, and is a member of the IMANZ Innovation & Technology Group. He is a LinkedIn Top Voice in Digital Marketing.

- MMM vs attribution: what marketing mix modelling tells you that last-click never will
  URL: https://adnan.co.nz/notes/mmm-vs-attribution
  Attribution shows which touchpoint was nearest a sale. Marketing mix modelling estimates what actually caused it. What MMM tells you, what it doesn't, and what to ask before you trust one.

  URL: https://adnan.co.nz/notes/genai-personalisation-customer-data
  Generative AI makes personalisation at scale possible, but only if the customer data underneath is unified, accurate and governed. What customer data infrastructure needs to look like.

### Marketing mix modelling
Marketing mix modelling estimates how marketing channels and outside factors contribute to business outcomes using aggregated historical data.

Stitch Predict (https://stitchpredict.com). Cookieless, privacy-safe causal attribution using ML. Models take 6 to 10 weeks to deploy, with ±6 to 10% variance, on 2 to 3 years of weekly variable data.

What's included:
- Stitch Predict marketing mix modelling
- Cookieless, privacy-safe causal attribution using machine learning
- 6 to 10 weeks to deploy, with ±6 to 10% variance
- 2 to 3 years of weekly variable data

## FAQ
### Who is Adnan Khan?
Adnan Khan is Co-Founder and Managing Partner of Stitch and Co-Founder of Stitch Predict, both based in Auckland, New Zealand. He has 19+ years in digital transformation, customer data, marketing technology, and AI, including senior roles at Meta (Facebook) and Microsoft. He is the IAB NZ AI Working Group Lead and Chair of the Marketing Association Digital SIG.

### What does Stitch do?
Stitch is an Auckland-based consultancy specialising in media, marketing, advertising, and data-driven technology. It builds customer data platforms, marketing automation, advanced measurement, and AI workflows for NZ and global brands including Turners, Tourism New Zealand, Mr Apple, World Vision New Zealand, Serko, RealNZ, Comvita, AA Smartfuel, BNZ and Bayleys.

### What is Stitch Predict?
Stitch Predict is a marketing mix modelling SaaS platform co-founded by Adnan Khan and Simon Wedde in 2023. It isolates the causal impact of each marketing activity on business outcomes using large data and machine learning, with no reliance on cookies or device tracking.

### How can I contact Adnan?
Email adnan.khan@me.com, phone +64 27 513 0110, or message him on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/adnan2/.

### Where is Adnan based?
Adnan is based in Auckland, New Zealand. Stitch is at Ground Floor, 295 Parnell Road, Parnell, Auckland 1052.

### What services does Adnan offer?
Adnan offers digital transformation, customer data platforms, marketing technology, media and advertising, and marketing mix modelling. He also offers AI strategy and advisory.

### What is marketing mix modelling (MMM)?
Marketing mix modelling (MMM) is statistical modelling that estimates how much each marketing channel and outside factor contributes to sales or other outcomes, using aggregated historical data rather than user-level tracking. Stitch Predict models take 6 to 10 weeks to deploy, with ±6 to 10% variance, on 2 to 3 years of weekly variable data.

### What is a customer data platform (CDP), and which ones does Adnan work with?
A customer data platform (CDP) is software that unifies first-party customer data from many sources into persistent profiles that marketing and other systems can use in real time. Adnan works with Tealium, mParticle, Segment, Salesforce CDP, Adobe Real-Time CDP and ActionIQ.

### What did Adnan do at Facebook (Meta)?
Adnan joined Facebook in August 2009 as the 5th Facebook employee in APAC and first Account Manager in Facebook APAC, and was one of the first 200 sales employees globally. He later became Client Partner NZ and Country Manager NZ (2013 to 2014).

### What awards has Adnan's work won?
Adnan's work has won the TVNZ Marketing Awards 2022 Supreme Award and three Gold Effies. Recognition also includes TVNZ Excellence in Brand Transformation Strategy and Excellence in Consumer Products & Services Strategy, 2022 Gold Effies in Strategic Thinking and Retail, Global Effie Finalist 2023, and LinkedIn Top Voice in Digital Marketing.
